summary: Found and fixed two gaps that hid the search-and-scrape extension's Settings → Extensions toggle. Added the missing `gizmoExtension` export to the registry entry so the extension registers with Gizmo's host, and fixed a bug in the Gizmo app's `discoverExtensionEntries` that skipped all Windows junction-linked extensions (causing the entire Pi section to be missing for linked extensions).
decisions: Add a minimal `gizmoExtension = { id: "search-and-scrape", name: "Search & Scrape" }` export to `pi-extension.ts` (and re-export from `index.ts`) — same pattern as the activity extension — so the extension appears under Settings → Extensions with an On/Off switch. No live operations are exposed because search and scrape are stateless tools and the web side is presentation-only.

Follow symlinks and stat the target in `discoverExtensionEntries` so Windows directory junctions/symlinks (used by registry linking) are recognized as directories rather than skipped — fixing discovery of every registry-linked extension, not just search-and-scrape.
errors: Initial WebSocket probe failed with `invalid_request` because the `resources.list` request takes `workspacePath`, not `projectPath` — fixed by switching the parameter name in the probe script.
